note.question: How do submodular order functions and assortment optimization interact?
note.overview: We define a new class of set functions that, in addition to being monotone and subadditive, also admit a very limited form of submodularity defined over a permutation of the ground set. We refer to this permutation as a submodular order. This class of functions includes monotone submodular functions as a subfamily.
